notes.title: 🐺 Tribe of Werewolves is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]📢 The Big Day is Here![/h2]

🎉 We are excited to announce: "Tribe of Werewolves" is now available on Steam! 🌕🐺 We are proud to bring this project we have been working on for a long time to you, our valued players.

⚔️ Step into the epic werewolf story with Tribe of Werewolves! Challenge enemies with your chosen character, experience unique gameplay with special weapons and magic combinations. Complete different quests on a massive map, uncover its hidden secrets, and prove your strength.

[h3]🕹️ Key Features:[/h3]

Legendary werewolf characters with unique weapons

Power-up combinations to create your own strategy

A deep gameplay experience that evolves over time

🛒 You can explore the game now on our Steam page and join this epic adventure!🔹 Click to visit the Steam Page

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156110/Tribe_of_Werewolves/

Don't forget to share your feedback with us when you play the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us!

🐾 Join your werewolf tribe, write your destiny! Thank you and have fun! 💙
